title: Never Cover the Back of Your HAND 🤚
description:
Never cover the back of your hand. In this town, everyone is born with half a glowing mark on it, and somewhere out there is the person with the rest. It can be a friend or family, whoever you fit with. My aunt teaches ballroom upstairs at the old dance hall on Tuesday nights. She has looked for her match for forty years, and this fall her half started to fade.

I play the records for her class in white gloves. I never dance. Then the floor started creaking behind her, in a stride far too long for anyone in the room.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment HAND if you'd check yours right now.
hold: cold-viewer check: the family 'other half' waltz can read as romance; say the family match plainly, early
